1.21.1.0.1971.0:
**New Feature ×5 · Editor ×3 · Menus & UI ×3 · New Content ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Train ×1**

### 0.1969.0

**Wall and fence styles in dimensional carriages**

Walls, fences, panes and bars in dimensional carriage builds can now join up or keep a fixed shape, just like in carriages.

**Edit groups without leaving the cell**

In the block variant menu, right-click a group entry to open that group's options right above, and change them without losing your place.

- Both menus stay open and usable
- Right-click the entry again to close it

**More to find on the train**

New places to explore in dimensional carriages, and a new kind of enemy carriage.

### 0.1968.0

**Community Rewards show what goes to the dev**

Every Community Reward now shows how much of your gift reaches the developer once it has paid its own running costs and card fees.

- Each reward reads "$X goes to the dev" under "For everyone", in your chosen currency
- The Contribute card's Give button always shows the amount
- Community Reward prices updated
- Clearer reward descriptions

**Borderless fullscreen**

The Modrinth modpack now comes with a borderless fullscreen option. Pick it from Fullscreen Mode in Video Settings to fill the screen without a title bar, and switch to other apps without the game minimising.

- Fullscreen Mode in Video Settings: Off, Exclusive, Borderless or Windowed

### 0.1967.0

**Faster block variant conditions**

Setting conditions on block variants in the editor takes fewer clicks, and you can see what each one is checking.

- Opening If on a row with no condition fills in the condition you last changed in that block
- While If is open, the blocks it checks are outlined in purple
1.21.1.0.1966.0:
**Train ×3 · Bug Fix ×2 · New Content ×1 · Loot ×1**

### 0.1964.0

**Room fixes**

A few rooms fit together and look a little better.

**World Border fix**

The world border no longer stands across the doorways of its carriages.

### 0.1963.0

**New rooms and carriage finds**

Four new rooms can now turn up behind dimensional carriage doors, two of them built by Nikeeta, and an old favourite has been reworked. Carriages have new things in them too, from suits of armour to beds piled with books.

- Four new rooms to discover as you ride
- Two of them built by Nikeeta
- New things to find inside carriages
1.21.1.0.1963.0:
**New Feature ×5 · Editor ×4 · Menus & UI ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Community ×1 · Train ×1 · Loot ×1**

### 0.1963.0

**Your passenger log in your own Discord**

Your own Discord webhooks can now get your passenger log too: your deaths, milestones and stories. Give each link a name, and pick what each one gets: Tributes, your passenger log, or both.

- Name each Discord webhook so you can tell them apart
- Choose Tributes, passenger log, or both for every link
- Links you already had keep getting Tributes only

### 0.1961.0

**Reference a group once per facing**

In the block variant editor, a Rot Free group can now be added to another cell several times, each copy facing a different way. Each row shows the block turned to its facing.

- Copy a Rot Free group's block, turn it, copy again: each Add keeps that facing
- Rows and the preview show the block facing the way it will be placed

### 0.1960.0

**World Border carriages**

Some dimensional carriages are now edged by a shimmering world border. Step through it and it turns red, and the space beyond is yours to build in.

- New World Border walls option for dimensional carriages in the editor

### 0.1958.0

**Block variant groups share their Copies setting**

In the editor, changing where a grouped block variant applies (the room, its copies, or both) now changes it for every block in the group, not just the one you clicked.

### 0.1957.0

**Editor: new blocks keep each cell's own rotation**

In a block variant group with free rotation, a block you add now faces the same way as the blocks already in each cell, instead of copying the cell you clicked.

- Stairs follow that cell's stairs, slabs its slabs, and anything else the most recent block's facing

### 0.1956.0

**Backpacks work while trading**

Your backpack now opens beside the trade screen, and trades can be paid straight from it.
1.21.1.0.1956.0:
**Bug Fix ×2 · Advancements ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1951.0

**Quiet after death**

After you die, the world behind the menu goes quiet: no more mobs, rain or wind playing on while you choose what comes next. The sound fades back in when you arrive.

### 0.1949.0

**Advancement fix**

Two advancements could unlock on their own right after boarding a new run. They now wait until you earn them.
1.21.1.0.1950.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Loot ×1 · Menus & UI ×1 · Balance ×1**

### 0.1949.0

**Cameras and backpacks are a little rarer**

Instant cameras and edible backpacks now turn up about a fifth less often in chests, pots, vases and vaults.

### 0.1948.0

**Shulker box fix**

Zombie hands can no longer open a shulker box from your hotbar.

### 0.1946.0

**Tell us what happened when the game freezes**

When the game asks to send a log after a freeze, there's now a Yes with info button. It opens the bug report with Lag already picked, so you can add what you were doing when it froze, and it's sent along with your logs.
1.21.1.0.1945.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Editor ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1945.0

**Editor quick toggles tidy-up and auto fly**

The editor's quick toggles are now a compact row of icons beside Settings. Turning the frame off no longer drops you out of your build, and a new Auto fly setting (on by default) catches you if you fall below the editor plots.
1.21.1.0.1944.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1944.0

**Record your deaths as videos**

A new option saves each death as a video: the 8 seconds before you died and the whole death scene, with game sound. Turn on Record Deaths in Options, General. It is off by default, since it keeps recording in the background while you play.

- Your death also replays behind the death screen
- Videos are saved to the dungeontrain/death-videos folder; click the file name in chat to watch
1.21.1.0.1943.0:
**Editor ×3 · Community ×3 · Bug Fix ×2 · New Feature ×1 · Performance ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1942.0

**Shared build fix**

Builds still saved on your computer that went missing from your profile now come back too, not only the ones kept in backups.

### 0.1940.0

**Community photos use much less data**

Community photos found on the train now download far less in the background. A game only fetches the photos it has room for, and fetches none while nobody is playing.

### 0.1939.0

**Shared build fix**

Your shared builds no longer show up twice in your profile.

- Builds put back after a lost upload now land on their existing entry instead of making a copy.
- Put-back builds upload at their real size, not several times larger.
- Saving a new build twice in quick succession makes one entry, not two.

**Quick toggles in the editor menu**

A small arrow beside Settings in the editor's X menu opens three one-click toggles, so you can switch common editor options without leaving the page you're on.

- Mirror: pause mirroring for every template at once. Each template keeps its own mirror axes for when you turn it back on.
- Menus: hide or show the floating editor menus; turning them back on returns to the mode you had.
- Frame: show or hide the carriage around Contents builds, so you can see and reach your build from every side. Also in Settings.
1.21.1.0.1938.0:
**Bug Fix ×3 · Menus & UI ×3 · New Feature ×1 · Editor ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Advancements ×1**

### 0.1937.0

**Trash slot tooltip fix**

The trash slot's tooltip no longer has item durability bars drawn over its text.

### 0.1935.0

**Builder menu fix**

Loading a very large shared build no longer stops to ask first, and its preview now says "No preview" instead of "Oversized".

**Death cinematic plays out**

Your first death now plays its cinematic all the way through, and every later one gives it a few seconds before you can skip.

- The first death's cinematic can't be skipped
- Skipping waits a few seconds after every death
- Change the view with the arrow keys; movement keys no longer cut the scene

### 0.1933.0

**Advancement fix**

Fixed an advancement that could be awarded without doing it.
1.21.1.0.1932.0:
# Go Out in Style

![Go Out in Style](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/go-out-in-style.gif)

Down but not out of frame. Ragdoll your way into the next life, on screen. Every death captured from a new dramatic camera angle. This update is setting up for something else big. What that is? You'll have to wait and see.

**Bug Fix ×1 · Compatibility ×1**

### 0.1932.0

**Startup crash fix**

The game no longer crashes at startup when another installed mod has trouble loading. It now recovers to the title screen.
1.21.1.0.1931.0:
**New Feature ×3 · Menus & UI ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Community ×1 · Mobs ×1 · Balance ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1930.0

**Testing tools improvement**

Behind-the-scenes work on the tools used to test Dungeon Train. Nothing changes in game.

### 0.1928.0

**Skeletons and evokers fight properly on the train**

Skeletons on the train now keep their distance and shoot from across the carriage instead of walking up to you, and evokers' fangs now rise from the carriage floor.

### 0.1927.0

**Echo skill graph reordered**

The skill graph on the echo death page now groups its corners more naturally: melee at the top, then blocking, quickswap, movement, placing, reading, trading and ranged.

**Show my name and Public name**

Options › Account now lets you choose how you appear outside the game. Show my name hides your name on Credits and on the website's reviews. Public name changes the name Credits and the website show, while your in-game name stays the same.

- Show my name: one switch for your name on Credits and website reviews
- Public name: change the name Credits and the website show you as
- Book Languages is now called Multi-lingual

### 0.1926.0

**Cracked blocks break faster**

Cracked blocks, like cracked stone bricks and cracked nether bricks, now break a little faster than their whole versions.
1.21.1.0.1926.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Mobs ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1926.0

**Named monsters**

Now and then a monster on the train has a name over its head.

### 0.1924.0

**Click the Stream preview to change what viewers see**

On the Options Stream tab, click the HUD, chat, name or pinned live feed in the preview to show or hide it for viewers. Hover a part to see what a click does. The new Preview setting puts the preview pinned below the settings, above or under the list, or turns it off.
1.21.1.0.1924.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Editor ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Train ×1 · Menus & UI ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1924.0

**Block variant groups can rotate freely**

Block variant groups in the train editor can now let each block face its own way while still sharing the same block, and there's a new carriage room to discover.

- Editor: a Rot Lock / Rot Free switch on block variant groups. Rot Free gives every block in the group its own facing and flip.
- A new carriage room.

### 0.1921.0

**AI Policy update**

New system to keep the AI Policy consistent with the website.

**Java safety check on CurseForge**

On CurseForge, MC Java Safety Check now installs as its own mod alongside Dungeon Train, so its page gets the credit. Nothing changes in game.
1.21.1.0.1920.0:
**New Feature ×3 · Mobs ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · New Content ×1 · Editor ×1 · Community ×1 · Train ×1**

### 0.1919.0

**More varied mob names**

Creatures more often get made-up names, and a few more are named after their kind or colour. Now and then a made-up name starts with a vowel.

### 0.1917.0

**Echo reading and trading**

The echo page on the death screen now shows how much your echo reads and trades. Its skill graph gains two corners, Reading and Trading, carried over from how you spent your life.

- Reading corner: the books you opened, how long you read them, and the books you wrote
- Trading corner: how many of the villagers you met you actually traded with
- Hover either corner to see its score

**More carriage rooms**

New maze, trap and passenger rooms can now turn up on the train.

- Two new maze rooms
- New trap rooms, so watch your step
- A new passenger room and a new room full of columns

**Send your Tributes to your own Discord**

Options > Account has a new Tribute webhook setting. Paste webhook links from your own Discord servers, up to 25, and every photo you pay Tribute to also posts in each of those channels.

- Works for your own photos and ones you find
- Send test checks a link before you pay a Tribute
1.21.1.0.1916.0:
**Bug Fix ×2 · New Feature ×1 · New Content ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Mobs ×1 · Loot ×1 · Books ×1 · Menus & UI ×1 · Balance ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1916.0

**New letters: a small writer**

A new set of letters waits on the train's lecterns, written by a very small, very brave new author who has only just learned to write.

### 0.1915.0

**Longer, smoother made-up names**

Made-up names on gear and creatures sometimes gain a second ending, and very rarely a third, with a vowel now and then to join them so they read easily. There are a few new endings too.

### 0.1914.0

**Totem tooltips show their level**

The Totem of Rage and Totem of Generosity tooltips now show the level and timer you will get for the stack you are holding, and the level they leave you at after they save you.

### 0.1912.0

**Totem of Generosity is more forgiving**

The Totem of Generosity gives you more time to give a gift (90 seconds instead of 60), and hurts half as often once you are late.

**Java safety check is now its own mod**

The Java safety warning now comes from MC Java Safety Check, a small mod bundled with Dungeon Train that any modpack can use. It looks and works the same, and if you chose "Don't show me again" it stays hidden.
1.21.1.0.1911.0:
**Bug Fix ×2 · Community ×1 · Train ×1**

### 0.1911.0

**Gift fix**

Gifts for friends now arrive in full.

### 0.1910.0

**Rest stop fix**

Rest stop fix.
1.21.1.0.1908.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Bug Fix ×1 · Compatibility ×1**

### 0.1908.0

**Fixed a crash when you die**

Dying no longer crashes the game. The modpack now ships the Interactive Player Mobs version the death screen needs, and Dungeon Train asks for it if yours is older.

### 0.1906.0

**Clearer bed messages**

Using a bed you placed, or one you moved, now tells you in chat that the train only lets you rest in a naturally spawning bed.
1.21.1.0.1905.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1904.0

**Java security warning**

If the Java your game runs on has the Java4Shell security flaw, Dungeon Train now tells you when the game starts and shows you how to fix it: update Java, or add one setting to your launcher.

- The steps match your setup, whether your Java comes from the Minecraft Launcher, CurseForge, Modrinth, Prism or your own install.
- Only computers the flaw affects see it. Macs with Apple chips never do.
1.21.1.0.1903.0:
# Echo Preview

![Echo Preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/meet-your-echo.png)

Preview your echo in the death screen, see the items, stats and personality you are leaving with it.

## Other significant updates

- Your echo's personality and traits, shaped by how you played
- A skill chart of how quick you were at melee, ranged, blocking, placing, movement and quickswap
- Look through the gear your echo carries, item by item

**New Feature ×6 · Editor ×4 · Community ×4 · Menus & UI ×4 · Bug Fix ×3 · Compatibility ×2**

### 0.1901.0

**Music player mods allowed**

Concerto, Dango Music and Show the Lyrics no longer put your run in Free Play. Their music and lyrics stay off your Live Eye stream, and a one-time notice tells you so.

- Play with Concerto, Dango Music or Show the Lyrics and keep your run ranked
- Their songs and lyrics never reach your Live Eye stream; your game sound and voice still do

### 0.1898.0

**Dungeon Train flags**

Builders get eight new Dungeon Train flags for their carriages. Each one turns into a Dungeon Train banner when the carriage appears, with a new design for every carriage.

- Flag 1 to Flag 8 in the Stage Blocks tab, placed on the floor or on a wall
- Every copy of the same flag number in a carriage matches, and different numbers never repeat a design
- Break one to keep it as a Dungeon Train banner
- Dungeon Train flags can now turn up in the shop and dressing room carriages

**Choose what your gift gives**

Donating for a friend? After paying, the thank-you page lets you choose which rewards go to them and which you keep. Your name stays on the boards unless you give that too.

- Turn a donation you just made into a gift, for up to a day after paying
- Pick which rewards your friend gets: Book Boosts, supporter perks, photo albums
- The name box suggests players who have ridden the train, so the gift reaches the right person

### 0.1896.0

**Chat button fix**

Chat buttons for Live Eye gifts, log requests and stream takeovers are better protected.

### 0.1895.0

**Build pictures load faster in the X menu**

Browsing a builder's creations in the train editor's X menu now fills every picture on screen first, shows the big builds too, and keeps the pictures while you scroll.

- Every build on screen gets its current picture before older versions start downloading. The build you select jumps the queue.
- Big builds that only showed their name now show a picture.
- Pictures stay loaded while you scroll and when you reopen the menu, and only download again when the build has changed.
- A small arrow marks the build that is downloading.

### 0.1894.0

**Leftover save folders cleaned up**

Runs you nap out of or reboard from no longer come back as nearly empty save folders, and any already left behind are cleared away when you reach the title screen.

### 0.1893.0

**Big builds flagged in the editor**

In the editor's build browser, a build too big to preview now says Oversized with its block count, and loading it into your world asks you to confirm first.

**Shared carriage stability**

Shared carriages and builds from other players load more reliably.

**See how big each build is**

The editor's build browser now shows how big each uploaded build is. A thin bar on every tile shows how close it is to the size limit, and the details panel lists its dimensions and data size as soon as you pick it.

- Size bar on every build tile: green, amber, then red near the limit
- Dimensions and data size shown before the preview finishes loading
1.21.1.0.1892.0:
**Bug Fix ×8 · Community ×2 · Editor ×1 · Multiplayer ×1 · Translations ×1 · Menus & UI ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1892.0

**Live chat report fix**

Reporting a bot from the Live chat is more reliable and better protected.

### 0.1890.0

**Builder fix**

Mobs placed in whole-carriage builds now spawn when the carriage is tested or ridden.

### 0.1889.0

**Translation fixes**

Recently added text reads better in all 21 languages, and the Live Eye now carries its new name in 14 more of them.

### 0.1888.0

**Resting fix**

Rests taken at a train bed carry over more safely.

### 0.1887.0

**Resting fix**

Resting at a train bed works more reliably.

**Save and Quit fix**

Save and Quit at train beds is safer when your world is open to LAN, and never clears away a world you named yourself.

**Safer donation links**

Donation and reward links get an extra safety check before they open, and the confirm screen now shows which site your browser will go to.

### 0.1886.0

**Discord status fix**

Your Discord status connects more reliably and no longer gets stuck when Discord stops answering.
1.21.1.0.1885.0:
**New Feature ×4 · Community ×2 · Train ×2 · Mobs ×2 · New Content ×1 · Bug Fix ×1 · Performance ×1 · Editor ×1 · World ×1**

### 0.1884.0

**Outdoor rooms in pen carriages**

Some pen carriages now open onto patches of the outdoors, and whatever lives there isn't friendly.

- New outdoor rooms in pen carriages, with enemies waiting in the grass
- A new crafting room
- Some zombie rooms now have stone pillars

**One-way dimensional carriages**

Some dimensional carriages now only open one way. Once you step in, the way you came is closed, so you will have to find the way out.

- Builders can make any dimensional carriage one-way from the editor.

### 0.1881.0

**Report bots in the Live chat**

Linked your Discord? You can now report bot spam from Kick and Twitch right from the Live chat, and the message disappears for everyone.

- A small flag sits after each Kick and Twitch message; click it, confirm, and the message is gone in game, on the website and on the stream.
- Linked before today? Type /discord once more to start reporting.

**Live Eye passes on when you step away**

Step away from the game for 2 minutes while wearing the Live Eye and it is offered to everyone watching, so the stream doesn't sit still. Come back before anyone takes it and the offer is withdrawn.

### 0.1880.0

**New mob name sounds**

Invented mob names get new sounds, like Kurdock, Jorfoot, Joltsmith and Hakswit.

### 0.1879.0

**Less lag in some flooded places**

Some flooded places along the line no longer fill the water with loose items as the train passes, so the ride stays smooth there.
1.21.1.0.1878.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Community ×1 · Mobs ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1877.0

**Smoother mob names**

Invented mob names no longer pile up vowels, so they're easier to read and say.

### 0.1876.0

**Explainers on the AI Policy**

The AI Policy page now ends with an Explainers section, starting with a look at how Dungeon Train's names are made without AI. Each one opens in your browser.

**Security fix**

Shared content from other players is now checked more strictly before your game reads it.
1.21.1.0.1875.0:
**New Feature ×5 · Mobs ×4 · Balance ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Menus & UI ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1875.0

**Two more mob name endings**

Invented mob names can now end in -nica or -leighly, like Hinica and Doleighly.

### 0.1873.0

**Dev command improvement**

Improved a developer command.

**Quit Game straight from a nap**

After you save and quit at a train bed, hold Shift on the farewell screens to quit the game instead of going to the main menu.

### 0.1872.0

**Echoes are slow at what you never did**

An echo is now only quick at the things you actually did quickly in that life. Anything you never did, it does slowly. Echoes from older lives each come back with reflexes of their own.

- A skill you never used leaves your echo at its slowest
- Older echoes get different reflexes every time they return

### 0.1871.0

**Echoes react at your speed for each thing they do**

An echo now fights, shoots, builds and moves as quickly as you did each of those things in that life. A sharp swordsman who fumbled the bow leaves an echo that swings fast but is slow to shoot.

- Shooting speed follows how often your arrows hit and how often you loosed them fully drawn
- Anything you never did, your echo does at your usual pace

### 0.1870.0

**More mob name sounds**

Invented mob names get new sounds and endings, so you'll meet names like Wamathon, Feiboard and Moewitle.
1.21.1.0.1869.0:
**Bug Fix ×1 · Balance ×1**

### 0.1869.0

**Totem of Breathlessness fix**

The Totem of Breathlessness curse now ends when the totem saves you, instead of drowning you on land after the save.
1.21.1.0.1868.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Mobs ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Loot ×1 · Menus & UI ×1 · Balance ×1**

### 0.1867.0

**Freshly invented mob names**

Mobs can now get names nobody has heard before, like Dongik or Kinkleberry, and those names also turn up as makers on gear. Player-like mobs still mostly look like real players. Dyed armour now credits whoever dyed it.

### 0.1866.0

**Echoes inherit your reflexes**

An echo now reacts as quickly as you did in that life. Quick hands leave a quick echo, and a slow life leaves a sluggish one.

- Striking back fast and landing the first hit count most
- Dodging arrows, keeping your hands busy and pushing on down the train count too

**Feedback note fix**

Sending feedback about saving no longer tells you saving is coming. Save and quit is already here.
